India faces England in crucial T20I match amid series struggles

The Indian cricket team is facing a critical fourth T20 International match against England, needing a win to stay in contention in the series. Reports indicate potential changes to the playing eleven, including the possible return of Sanju Samson and Washington Sundar, to strengthen the team's batting and bowling. This match comes after a series of defeats, prompting discussions about performance reviews within the BCCI.
